I'm Dr. Bri! I'm a Doctor of Physical Therapy, making pelvic wellness fun, accessible, and available to EVERYONE. I offer follow-along workouts to educate and empower you: mind, body, spirit, and pelvic floor. 💕

DISCLAIMER: This content is for informational purposes only. It is general and not intended to be medical advice, nor does using it create a physical therapist-patient relationship between you and Brianne Grogan. Before starting, consult your healthcare provider for a proper diagnosis and ensure this content is safe and appropriate for your medical and physical condition. Stop or modify immediately if you experience pain or increased pelvic symptoms. Brianne Grogan (FemFusion Wellness LLC) makes no representations about the accuracy or suitability of this content for you. By voluntarily using this content, you assume all risks for any resulting losses, injuries, or damages.
